form.label: Cisco Duo Audit - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Cisco Duo Admin API authentication, activity, telephony, Trust Monitor, user/phone inventory, and integration inventory JSON relay overview. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | stats count

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="authentication" (result="failure" OR result="fraud" OR action="failure" OR action="fraud") | stats count
index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (event_type="activity" OR event_type="telephony") | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Duo family

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval family=coalesce(duo_family, event_type, "duo_audit") | timechart count by family
index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval family=coalesce(duo_family, event_type, "duo_audit") | stats count by family | sort -count

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval duo_action=coalesce(action, vendor_raw_action, result, event_type) | stats count by duo_action | sort -count | head 20

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval duo_user=coalesce(user, src_user, email, username, 'user.name', 'actor.name') | stats count by duo_user | sort -count | head 20
index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip, src, 'access_device.ip', ip) | stats count by source_ip | sort -count | head 20

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | eval duo_app=coalesce(app, 'application.name', 'application.destination_name') | stats count by duo_app | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: MFA factors, reasons, and telephony usage

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search (event_type="authentication" OR event_type="telephony") | eval factor=coalesce(factor,"n/a"), reason=coalesce(reason,"n/a"), result=coalesce(result,status,"n/a"), type=coalesce(type,"n/a"), context=coalesce(context,"n/a"), credits=coalesce(credits,"n/a") | stats count by event_type factor reason result type context credits | sort -count | head 50

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="telephony" | table _time host context type credits phone telephony_id txid marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="activity" | eval duo_user=coalesce(user, username, 'actor.name') | table _time host duo_user action object object_type signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="trust_monitor" | eval duo_user=coalesce(user, 'surfaced_auth.user.name', 'enabled_for.name'), trust_reason=coalesce(trust_explanation_type, priority_reason_type) | table _time host type state priority_event triaged_as_interesting duo_user src_ip app trust_reason signature_id sekey marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="user_phone_inventory" | table _time host user user_id user_status phone_id phone_platform phone_model phone_type phone_last_seen phone_encrypted phone_screenlock phone_tampered marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: Duo integration and Admin API permission inventory

search.query: index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | search event_type="integration_inventory" | table _time host integration_key integration_name integration_type adminapi_read_log adminapi_read_resource adminapi_integrations adminapi_settings adminapi_write_resource user_access groups_allowed policy_key prompt_v4_enabled frameless_auth_prompt_enabled networks_for_api_access marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host event_type | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=main sourcetype="cisco:duo:audit:json" host=$host_tok$ | extract reload=true | table _time host event_type duo_family user src_ip app action vendor_raw_action signature signature_id status factor reason object object_type context type credits phone telephony_id txid sekey state surfaced_timestamp priority_event triaged_as_interesting trust_explanation_type priority_reason_type user_id user_status phone_id phone_platform phone_model phone_type phone_last_seen phone_encrypted phone_screenlock phone_tampered phone_capabilities integration_key integration_name integration_type adminapi_read_log adminapi_read_resource adminapi_integrations adminapi_settings adminapi_write_resource user_access groups_allowed policy_key prompt_v4_enabled frameless_auth_prompt_enabled networks_for_api_access marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
